systems.system: OpenHIM Platform with FHIR-based health information exchange

SWZ.note: The only exchange described is between health facilities, a sector system and not a government-wide data exchange platform.

facts.fact: Jembi says healthcare facilities in Eswatini can now share demographic and clinical patient information in near real-time through a FHIR-based exchange on the OpenHIM Platform, with a Master Patient Index integrated; no facility count is given.
facts.system: OpenHIM Platform / FHIR-based health information exchange with Master Patient Index

systems.system: OpenHIM Platform / FHIR-based health information exchange with Master Patient Index
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (implemented by Jembi with DataFI)

SWZ.note: as_of is the published date (year inferred by the source's own note); no go-live date is given. Scaling to more facilities is listed as a next step, so no breadth fact; the Population Registry is used for patient identification but is not stated to be the national ID, so no identifier fact.
The Master Patient Index integrates the Population Registry for patient identification, but the story does not call it the national ID or describe a verification against it.
